narrative.v032.orin_summary.node.answer: Hale kept the records private to stop the system being reused. I objected, but also kept my copy private. Ask both of us for evidence. Rook holds an old transport access card.
narrative.v032.orin_summary.node.accepte: Take the comparison with you. Ask Rook where that card has been used.
narrative.v032.orin_summary.node.decline: You can review our comparisons before leaving.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.choice.accep: I will examine the warehouse invoice.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.choice.ask: Is there paperwork that can verify his account?
narrative.v032.rook_contact.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.node.start: I delivered crates to Rook with the same black-card mark. He called them ordinary goods, but received them after the warehouse closed.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.choice.confi: I will examine the warehouse invoice.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.node.answer: The warehouse has an invoice from one shipment. Read it first. Rook gives better answers when he knows you have seen the paperwork.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.node.accepte: I will point out which invoice belongs to that shipment.
narrative.v032.rook_contact.node.decline: The invoice is staying here. You can return later.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.choice.acce: I will ask Rook about this invoice.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.node.start: The Black Card originally allowed emergency Warden transport. This shipment was opened after closing, under the name of someone not on duty.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.choice.conf: I will ask Rook about this invoice.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.node.answer: A transport company's warehouse in the sixth town. The receiving mark is linked to Rocket. Rook needs to explain why his card was used there.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.node.accept: Keep the destination and receiving mark together.
narrative.v032.black_invoice.node.declin: Compare the paperwork further before drawing a conclusion.
narrative.v032.rook_battle.choice.ask: Why do I need to battle for it?
narrative.v032.rook_battle.choice.declin: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rook_battle.node.start: Read the invoice? I have the card. Before I hand it over, show me you can keep it when someone wants it back.
narrative.v032.rook_battle.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rook_battle.node.answer: Warehouse staff will not step aside for paperwork alone. I want to know you can get your party out. Win, and I give you the card and what I know.
narrative.v032.rook_battle.node.accepted: All right. Win this, and I keep my end of the agreement.
narrative.v032.rook_battle.node.declined: The card stays with me. No need to pretend you are ready.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.choice.accep: I will compare the shipment with Selene.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.choice.ask: Was Iris involved in the shipment?
narrative.v032.rook_warning.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.node.start: That invoice is from last week. Selene says the warehouse closed long ago. Someone is leaving part of the story out.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.choice.confi: I will compare the shipment with Selene.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.node.answer: She once asked me to take a copy of some records outside. I kept the receipt. Check the vehicle with Selene before blaming Iris for this.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.node.accepte: Take the receipt. Compare what each of us actually claims.
narrative.v032.rook_warning.node.decline: Read the receipt first. I do not need an immediate verdict.
narrative.v032.selene_local.choice.accep: I will check the log at the guard post.
narrative.v032.selene_local.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.selene_local.node.start: A League truck came through at night. The roadside leaves were burnt the next morning. Selene said it carried medicine, so I kept the gate log.
narrative.v032.selene_local.choice.confi: I will check the log at the guard post.
narrative.v032.selene_local.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.selene_local.node.answer: Selene signed. But the gate paper records the medicine shipment, not what the truck actually carried. Check the delivery order too.
narrative.v032.selene_local.node.accepte: Look at the delivery order alongside the gate log.
narrative.v032.selene_local.node.decline: The log is still there. I have not given it away.
narrative.v032.selene_log.choice.accept: I will ask Selene about the changed order.
narrative.v032.selene_log.choice.ask: So her signature does not prove she changed the cargo?
narrative.v032.selene_log.choice.decline: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.selene_log.node.start: Selene's paper lists medicine. The delivery order was changed to record-storage equipment, confirmed by the League office.
narrative.v032.selene_log.choice.confirm: I will ask Selene about the changed order.
narrative.v032.selene_log.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.selene_log.node.answer: Correct. It proves she approved the original medicine shipment. Rook may be right about the truck while Selene is right about the cargo she was told about.
narrative.v032.selene_log.node.accepted: You retain both versions of the order.
narrative.v032.selene_log.node.declined: Keep both papers so the truck and its cargo do not get confused.
narrative.v032.selene_battle.choice.ask: You still do not trust me?
narrative.v032.selene_battle.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.selene_battle.node.start: You brought both papers. Good. I will trace the edit, but first I need to know you can protect the originals.
narrative.v032.selene_battle.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.selene_battle.node.answer: I trust that you checked. At the warehouse they will pressure you to give up what you are carrying. This battle shows me how you handle pressure.
narrative.v032.selene_battle.node.accept: All right. Keep your attention on the battle; we can examine the order afterward.
narrative.v032.selene_battle.node.declin: Needing time to prepare does not mean refusing the investigation.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.choice.a: I will bring the evidence to the Warden station.
What should I take to the Warden?
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.choice.d: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.node.sta: I will send the log to Mara. Wardens manage emergency warehouse access. If the card was copied, they need to know.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.choice.c: I will bring the evidence to the Warden station.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.choice.l: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.node.ans: The changed order and card mark. They show access was misused, not that every Warden was involved.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.node.acc: Take those two records. I will send my copy to Mara.
narrative.v032.selene_aftermath.node.dec: I will keep a copy so your journey cannot lose our only lead.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.choice.acce: I will compare the duty board.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.choice.ask: Does the station record when the truck arrives?
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.node.start: Pokémon avoid this road when the truck comes, but not when people walk by. I want to check its cargo.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.choice.conf: I will compare the duty board.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.node.answer: Yes, on the duty board. Read the dates, then report them. I need a safe rescue route, not another rumor about a truck.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.node.accept: Compare the dates before reporting to the Warden.
narrative.v032.warden_ranger.node.declin: I marked those days. You can read them later.
narrative.v032.warden_log.choice.accept: I will report the account that needs checking.
narrative.v032.warden_log.choice.ask: Can the Warden revoke it now?
narrative.v032.warden_log.choice.decline: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.warden_log.node.start: Three warehouse-opening orders use the name of an employee who left years ago. Their account is still accepted.
narrative.v032.warden_log.choice.confirm: I will report the account that needs checking.
narrative.v032.warden_log.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.warden_log.node.answer: Yes, but the warehouse must remain open for rescues. Identify the abused access so the whole station does not lose its supplies.
narrative.v032.warden_log.node.accepted: You retain the three orders identifying the old account.
narrative.v032.warden_log.node.declined: You can review the orders before reporting.
narrative.v032.warden_six.choice.accept: I am ready for the test.
narrative.v032.warden_six.choice.ask: What does your test focus on?
narrative.v032.warden_six.choice.decline: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.warden_six.node.start: I will revoke the old account. Before you investigate the warehouse, I need to know you can bring your party home.
narrative.v032.warden_six.choice.confirm: I am ready for the test.
narrative.v032.warden_six.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.warden_six.node.answer: Keeping a party able to fight when forced to switch. Access does not authorize destroying equipment or chasing people alone.
narrative.v032.warden_six.node.accepted: Then show me how you keep your party together under pressure.
narrative.v032.warden_six.node.declined: Prepare your party and return. There is no need to issue access prematurely.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.choice.acce: I will meet Duc before entering.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.choice.ask: What should I do first if I find Iris?
narrative.v032.warden_orders.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.node.start: Rocket rented the warehouse under a transport company's name. Duc works nights there. He can show you an entrance that will not alert the whole building.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.choice.conf: I will meet Duc before entering.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.node.answer: Get her to safety. Keep evidence if you can, but do not leave a person behind to bring back more equipment.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.node.accept: Meet Duc first. Bring Iris out before worrying about the machines.
narrative.v032.warden_orders.node.declin: We will keep the records at the station while you prepare.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.choice.a: I will check the delivery board.
How can I find the way down?
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.choice.d: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.node.sta: I hear Pokémon battles below the warehouse. The morning shift log says the basement is unused. Vex reads that log every day.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.choice.c: I will check the delivery board.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.choice.l: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.node.ans: The side door accepts the Black Card. The delivery board lists crates sent below. Read it before passing the checkpoints.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.node.acc: Start with the board. It shows which corridor the deliveries use.
narrative.v032.rocket_informant.node.dec: I have not led anyone downstairs. Prepare first.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.choice.accep: I will follow the route on the delivery record.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.choice.ask: Will the Black Card open all three checkpoints?
narrative.v032.rocket_route.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.node.start: The copying machines are labeled fragile cargo. The basement has a separate power line and three checkpoints.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.choice.confi: I will follow the route on the delivery record.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.node.answer: No. It only gets you through the side door. Guards check people after that. The delivery record shows the route to Iris's room.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.node.accepte: You retain the route and the locations of the three checkpoints.
narrative.v032.rocket_route.node.decline: Read the route again before entering if you need to.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.choice.acce: I will battle to pass the checkpoint.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.choice.ask: Do you know someone is being held downstairs?
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.node.start: The card is accepted. Its holder is not. My orders keep strangers outside this checkpoint.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.choice.conf: I will battle to pass the checkpoint.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.node.answer: I know there is a restricted room. I cannot see its occupant list. Beat me if you want to pass.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.node.accept: Fine. This checkpoint opens if you win.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard1.node.declin: Stay outside, then. I do not chase people who have not entered.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.choice.ac: I will find the way to Iris's room.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.choice.as: What does Vex want the records for?
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.choice.de: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.node.star: Vex: 'Keep the battle history. Delete the participants.' Iris: 'Bad data will make the system misidentify Pokémon.'
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.choice.co: I will find the way to Iris's room.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.choice.la: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.node.answ: Rocket forges access and sells it as valid cards. One repeatedly erased record starts with T. Iris is being forced to edit that data.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.node.acce: You retain the exchange as evidence and continue toward Iris.
narrative.v032.rocket_overhear.node.decl: You can listen again before moving on.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.choice.acce: I accept the battle. Let us see how long you can hold it.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.choice.ask: Whose orders are you waiting for?
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.node.start: The first checkpoint let you through? I have no orders to admit visitors to the machines.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.choice.conf: I accept the battle. Let us see how long you can hold it.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.node.answer: Vex's. Until then, I keep you here. My party does not need to finish quickly; it just needs to keep you away from the door.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.node.accept: Then I will stop you at this checkpoint.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard2.node.declin: If you stay back, I have no reason to start yet.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.choice.acce: I will battle to clear the way.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.node.start: Past this door is an area absent from the visitor map. You have come too far to be lost.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.choice.conf: I will battle to clear the way.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.node.answer: She works inside under Vex's supervision. I hold the door. Win if you want it opened.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.node.accept: All right. I am not stepping aside without a battle.
narrative.v032.rocket_guard3.node.declin: Step back and the battle has not begun.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.choice.accept: I will defeat you and bring Iris out.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.choice.ask: Does their wrongdoing justify holding Iris?
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.choice.decline: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.node.start: The League erased these names before I found them. You demand answers from me; did you ask them the same questions?
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.choice.confirm: I will defeat you and bring Iris out.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.node.answer: No. I needed her to run the machine, and I kept her here. Beat me if you want to take her and the records out.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.node.accepted: Then we settle who controls that door in this battle.
narrative.v032.rocket_vex.node.declined: Stop there if you are not ready to battle. I have not handed over access.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.choice.accept: I will take the original and bring you out.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.choice.declin: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.node.start: I edited a report to keep our research group open. Rocket found the original and used it to force more work from me. I am not innocent.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.choice.confir: I will take the original and bring you out.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.node.answer: A separate reader contains an unedited copy. Take it, then we leave by the delivery door. I will explain what I did using the original.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.node.accepted: Take the reader's copy. I will follow you to the delivery door.
narrative.v032.iris_rescue.node.declined: I will keep the reader here. Do not erase the data yourself.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.choice.acce: I will bring the original to Marlow.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.choice.ask: Do those signatures identify who ordered the deletion?
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.node.start: The erased trainer is named TOBA. The original has signatures from Hale, Aurelia and someone at the School of Wolf.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.choice.conf: I will bring the original to Marlow.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.node.answer: Not yet. It does not give the reason. I will keep a copy; you keep the original. Marlow knows the archive system from before the current League.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.node.accept: You retain the original, including all three signatures.
narrative.v032.iris_terminal.node.declin: Keep this version intact if you want to examine it further.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.choice.acc: I will examine the old photograph.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.choice.ask: What can you read from that mark?
narrative.v032.marlow_account.choice.dec: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.node.start: The printed photo and digital record both omit a person. The old print still has an embossed mark the scan missed.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.choice.con: I will examine the old photograph.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.choice.lat: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.node.answe: The Black Card was an old rescue credential, not Rocket's invention. The date beneath the photo may connect the erased record to that rescue.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.node.accep: Start with the date below the photograph.
narrative.v032.marlow_account.node.decli: I will leave the print at the comparison table.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.choice.accep: I will take this lead to the Seventh Warden.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.choice.ask: Who can confirm what happened there?
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.node.start: TOBA stands beside Hale in the rescue team. Its date matches an incident the League records call an exercise.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.choice.confi: I will take this lead to the Seventh Warden.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.node.answer: The Seventh Warden keeps that area. He can grant access after a safety test. This photo gives you something specific to ask, not the whole answer.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.node.accepte: You keep the photograph and incident date together.
narrative.v032.marlow_photo.node.decline: Compare the photos further if you need to.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.choice.accep: I am ready to battle for access.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.choice.ask: Who should I see about the rescue records afterward?
narrative.v032.warden_seven.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.node.start: I know part of the record was hidden. I also know the area is still dangerous. Pass my test before entering.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.choice.confi: I am ready to battle for access.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.node.answer: Liora at the eighth town's harbor kept the final ship's records. Bring the photo and date, not just a story you heard.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.node.accepte: Then show me that your party can handle the journey.
narrative.v032.warden_seven.node.decline: I do not grant access before you are ready.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.choice.acce: I will compare the list on the board.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.choice.ask: Is the original list still at the harbor?
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.node.start: Show me the photograph and its date. Before opening the rescue list, I need to know which voyage you are comparing.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.choice.conf: I will compare the list on the board.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.node.answer: Yes, on the operations board. The ship returned one person short. Read it first; Dorian will receive you for the final qualifier afterward.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.node.accept: Read the original beside the public version.
narrative.v032.liora_harbour.node.declin: The harbor keeps the records. There is no need to rush.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.choice.a: I will meet Dorian and continue comparing the records.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.choice.d: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.node.sta: The original says TOBA did not board the returning ship. The public version says he did not join the rescue.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.choice.c: I will meet Dorian and continue comparing the records.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.choice.l: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.node.ans: It erases that he went with the team at all. Liora cannot open the deeper record; the Battle Tower holds the final confirmation. Dorian's qualifier is the next step.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.node.acc: You retain both versions of the passenger record.
narrative.v032.harbour_manifest.node.dec: Keep both versions instead of treating them as equivalent.
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.choice.a: What does a rain team test?
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.choice.d: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.node.sta: Liora sent your record. This is the final coastal round before the Battle Tower. My rain team is ready.
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.choice.l: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.node.ans: Keeping your party effective when the weather changes, rather than relying on one Pokémon. Pass and you can enter the archive holding the final confirmation.
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.node.acc: Then we begin the final coastal round.
narrative.v032.dorian_qualifier.node.dec: Prepare first. I will keep your place in the qualifier.
narrative.v032.false_victory.choice.acce: I will take the confirmation to the Tower.
narrative.v032.false_victory.choice.ask: What is wrong with that confirmation?
narrative.v032.false_victory.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.false_victory.node.start: You passed the final round. Congratulations. A new confirmation just arrived for your record, and something is wrong with it.
narrative.v032.false_victory.choice.conf: I will take the confirmation to the Tower.
narrative.v032.false_victory.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.false_victory.node.answer: It bears TOBA's signature, dated today. The missing person is being recorded as a results approver. The Battle Tower needs to explain it.
narrative.v032.false_victory.node.accept: Take my copy too. Ask them how that signature was accepted.
narrative.v032.false_victory.node.declin: Look at the signature again first. I kept an extra copy.
narrative.v032.tower_entry.choice.ask: Can I read those confirmations now?
narrative.v032.tower_entry.choice.declin: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.tower_entry.node.start: Your qualifier record is valid. You face Rowan, Nyx, then Orion. Each holds a confirmation from the old system.
narrative.v032.tower_entry.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.tower_entry.node.answer: They belong to the trial records. Complete each battle in order to open the next copy. Your place is registered.
narrative.v032.tower_entry.node.accepted: Rowan is first. We will record each round separately.
narrative.v032.tower_entry.node.declined: Your place will remain registered when you return.
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.choice.ask: How is your trial different from the qualifier?
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.choice.declin: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.node.start: My copy lists TOBA as the winner. The public version has no such battle. Pass my trial to examine the full copy.
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.node.answer: I watch how you prepare for the next turn. A good move leaves your party room to respond when the opponent changes plans.
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.node.accepted: Then let us see how you prepare for the turn after this one.
narrative.v032.tower_rowan.node.declined: The record is staying here. Prepare first.
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.choice.ask: What should I watch about the tempo?
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.choice.decline: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.node.start: My copy awards all points for TOBA's battle. The League calls it cancelled. After my tempo trial, you can compare them.
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.node.answer: Do not attack only because your turn arrived. My party can change action order. Notice when waiting gives you an advantage.
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.node.accepted: All right. The tempo trial begins with this battle.
narrative.v032.tower_nyx.node.declined: I am not timing your preparation.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.choice.accept: I will battle to open the next record.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.choice.ask: Do you know who changed the order?
narrative.v032.tower_orion.choice.declin: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.node.start: Aurelia ordered the record kept private. The public version made that a deletion. Distinguish those two decisions.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.choice.confir: I will battle to open the next record.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.node.answer: Not enough evidence to name someone. Pass this trial and you may take the order to Aurelia herself.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.node.accepted: Then earn access to the order itself.
narrative.v032.tower_orion.node.declined: Keep that question. Taking time to prepare does not make it less valid.
narrative.v032.league_entry.choice.ask: Who do I meet before Aurelia?
narrative.v032.league_entry.choice.decli: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.
narrative.v032.league_entry.node.start: Aurelia received your request. The records will be preserved, including the parts this office needs to explain.
narrative.v032.league_entry.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.league_entry.node.answer: Cassian, Seraph and Kael, in order. Each kept a separate account of the old experiment. After those battles, the Champion will receive you.
narrative.v032.league_entry.node.accepte: Your first appointment is with Cassian.

narrative.v032.elite_cassian.choice.decl: Not yet. I would like to leave this for later.

narrative.v032.elite_cassian.choice.late: I understand. I need some time to think.
narrative.v032.elite_cassian.node.answer: The rescue system needed the result to keep running. When we could not establish whether TOBA lived, we allowed his name to be erased. You receive my record after this battle.

narrative.v032.elite_cassian.node.declin: I will still owe you that answer when you return.

narrative.v032.elite_seraph.node.accepte: Then we battle. Keep the comparison with the original order afterward.
narrative.v032.elite_seraph.node.decline: Pausing does not mean abandoning your question.
narrative.v032.elite_kael.choice.accept: I accept. Afterward I want your full account.

narrative.v032.elite_kael.choice.later: I understand. I need some time to think.

narrative.v032.elite_kael.node.accepted: Then we begin. My account will carry my own name.
narrative.v032.elite_kael.node.declined: I will keep that promise even if you need more time.

narrative.v032.champion_aurelia.choice.l: I understand. I need some time to think.

I will read the original at the School.
I understand. I need some time to think.

narrative.v032.aurelia_aftermath.node.de: Your access remains, even if you do not leave immediately.

narrative.v032.archive_record2.choice.la: I understand. I need some time to think.

How can I help keep contact?
Keep your phone on. If you reach Iris, let her speak directly rather than passing her account through several people.
I will check whether Iris is safe.
Be careful. Her safety comes first; the records come after that.

narrative.v032.phone.rook.after_defeat.r: Fine. If she disagrees with me, send her exact words. I dislike being quoted halfway.

I will record the unresolved differences.

I will read the files before agreeing to meet.

I will examine the evidence first.
